1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 10 m de altura, con hojas ovaladas, flores pequeñas, fragantes, de color blanquecino y fruto ovalado. Sapotaceae; Chrysophyllum oliviforme.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 10 m, with oval-shaped leaves, small fragrant flowers of a whitish color, and an oval fruit. Sapotaceae; Chrysophyllum oliviforme.
